title: Revolut partners with OpenAI to bundle ChatGPT Go into its subscriptions

content_html:
Revolut is handing its customers free access to ChatGPT, the result of a new partnership with OpenAI. The fintech, which says it now serves more than 75 million people worldwide, is bundling OpenAI’s ChatGPT Go into its subscription plans, giving anywhere from three months to a year of the service at no extra cost.

The perk scales with how much you already pay. Revolut’s top Ultra tier gets twelve months of ChatGPT Go plus a twelve-month “buddy pass” to hand a friend, Metal gets a year, Premium and Revolut Pro get six months, and even the free Standard tier gets three months as a promotion.

This is not Revolut’s first move into AI. The company has built its own in-app assistant, called AIR, and is reported to lean on OpenAI’s models behind the scenes for fraud monitoring and customer support, so the ChatGPT perk sits on top of a deeper relationship.

The rollout is staggered. Paid subscribers and Revolut Pro users can redeem the benefit immediately in the app, while Plus and Standard customers will get it over the coming weeks, a familiar pattern of rewarding the higher tiers first.

What they are getting is the paid-lite version of ChatGPT. ChatGPT Go, powered by OpenAI’s GPT-5.6, offers higher usage limits, file uploads and document analysis, image generation, and memory, the features that separate a casual chatbot from a daily tool.

For Revolut, the logic is bundling. The company has spent years stuffing its subscriptions with perks, from airport lounges to insurance, and it now puts the value of that portfolio at around €4,100 a year, with a marquee AI product the obvious next thing to add.

“We want to empower our customers with tools that accompany their entire daily lives while going beyond the financial,” said Tara Massoudi, the company’s general manager for premium products, casting ChatGPT as a lifestyle benefit rather than a banking feature.

For OpenAI, the appeal is distribution. “We’re excited to partner with Revolut and bring ChatGPT Go to millions of customers worldwide,” said Emmanuel Marill, OpenAI’s managing director for EMEA, in a deal that puts its product in front of tens of millions of users in a single stroke.

That is the pattern worth watching. OpenAI has been pushing ChatGPT into workplaces and consumer apps alike, and partnerships like this one turn other companies’ user bases into on-ramps for its subscriptions.

OpenAI is making the same move elsewhere in European finance. It struck a parallel deal with the London Stock Exchange Group around the same time, part of a push to embed its models inside the continent’s biggest institutions rather than only its own apps.

The Revolut deal is a clean version of the trade. The bank gets a shiny perk to sell memberships, OpenAI gets millions of potential paying users once the free months end, and the customer gets up to a year of ChatGPT for a subscription they may already hold.

It is worth being precise about what this is, and is not. The perk is a free ChatGPT subscription, not a pipe feeding your bank balance into an AI, and Revolut is not handing OpenAI your transaction history to unlock it.

But the direction of travel is unmistakable. The lines between banking apps and AI assistants are blurring, and OpenAI has made no secret that it wants ChatGPT closer to your finances, a prospect that carries real convenience and real risk in equal measure.

For now, the offer is simple enough. Tens of millions of Revolut customers are about to find ChatGPT Go waiting in their app, and OpenAI has just landed one of the largest consumer distribution deals a fintech can offer, one membership tier at a time.

content_html_zh:
Revolut 正在向其客户免费提供 ChatGPT，这是与 OpenAI 建立新合作伙伴关系的成果。 这家金融科技公司表示，目前为全球超过 7500 万人提供服务，并将 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Go 捆绑到其订阅计划中，为任何地方提供三个月到一年的服务，无需额外付费。

福利根据您已经支付的金额而定。 Revolut 的顶级 Ultra 级别获得 12 个月的 ChatGPT Go 以及可送给朋友的 12 个月的“好友通行证”，Metal 获得一年，Premium 和 Revolut Pro 获得六个月，甚至免费的 Standard 级别也获得三个月的促销。

这并不是 Revolut 第一次进军人工智能领域。 该公司已经构建了自己的应用内助手，名为 AIR，据报道在幕后依靠 OpenAI 的模型来进行欺诈监控和客户支持，因此 ChatGPT 的福利建立在更深层次的关系之上。

推出是交错进行的。 付费订阅者和 Revolut Pro 用户可以立即在应用程序中兑换该福利，而 Plus 和 Standard 客户将在未来几周内获得该福利，这是首先奖励较高级别的常见模式。

他们得到的是 ChatGPT 的付费精简版。 ChatGPT Go 由 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 提供支持，提供更高的使用限制、文件上传和文档分析、图像生成和内存，这些功能将休闲聊天机器人与日常工具区分开来。

对于 Revolut 来说，逻辑就是捆绑。 该公司多年来一直在其订阅服务中提供各种福利，从机场休息室到保险，现在该投资组合的价值约为每年 4,100 欧元，而下一步显然要增加的就是一款大牌人工智能产品。

该公司高级产品总经理塔拉·马苏迪 (Tara Massoudi) 表示：“我们希望为客户提供陪伴他们整个日常生活的工具，同时超越金融功能。”她将 ChatGPT 视为一种生活方式福利，而不是银行功能。

对于 OpenAI 来说，吸引力在于分发。 OpenAI 欧洲、中东和非洲地区董事总经理 Emmanuel Marill 表示：“我们很高兴与 Revolut 合作，将 ChatGPT Go 带给全球数百万客户。”这笔交易将其产品一次性推向数千万用户。

这是值得关注的模式。 OpenAI 一直在将 ChatGPT 推向工作场所和消费者应用程序等领域，而像这样的合作伙伴关系将其他公司的用户群转变为其订阅的入口。

OpenAI 正在欧洲其他金融领域采取同样的举措。 大约在同一时间，它与伦敦证券交易所集团达成了一项平行协议，这是推动将其模型嵌入欧洲大陆最大机构而不仅仅是其自己的应用程序的一部分。

Revolut 交易是该交易的干净版本。 银行通过出售会员资格获得了闪亮的福利，一旦免费月份结束，OpenAI 就会获得数百万潜在的付费用户，而客户可以通过他们可能已经持有的订阅获得长达一年的 ChatGPT。

值得准确说明这是什么，不是什么。 这项福利是免费的 ChatGPT 订阅，而不是将您的银行余额输入 AI 的管道，并且 Revolut 不会向 OpenAI 提供您的交易历史记录来解锁它。

但行进的方向是明确无误的。 银行应用程序和人工智能助手之间的界限正在变得模糊，OpenAI 毫不掩饰地表示，它希望 ChatGPT 更贴近您的财务状况，这种前景既带来真正的便利，也带来真正的风险。

就目前而言，这个优惠很简单。 数以千万计的 Revolut 客户即将发现 ChatGPT Go 在他们的应用程序中等待，而 OpenAI 刚刚获得了金融科技可以提供的最大的消费者分销交易之一，一次一个会员级别。
